ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of low-intensity black pixels (central region and trailing margins) to high-intensity white/grey pixels (lateral lobe surfaces).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central anchor extending to the trailing edge. High-intensity white fields on the lateral lobes show dense, non-contiguous grey stippling and mottling transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped cleft with an interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and significant vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; notably higher amplitude jaggedness and protruding clusters at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curvature characterized by a concave arc near the median notch transitioning to a convex arc toward the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast circular clusters at the distal tips corresponding to barnacle attachment; several small isolated white circular points visible on the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear grey-on-white streaks visible on the medial-lateral portions of both lobes, primarily oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization (calcified clusters) visible on the extreme outer trailing edges of both the left and right fluke lobes.
